_context.settings.scopeTitle: Heading of the list of notification scopes (what you get notified about).

_context.inbox.detail.status.awaiting_ack: Kind of a notification: something a coworker flagged that the user has not read yet.
_context.notices: Notices the app sends the whole workspace (in-app and by email) about a paid app (LinkedIn Pro, WhatsApp Pro) or the credits. {provider} is LinkedIn or WhatsApp, {account} the name of the connected account. Settings → Apps names a screen of the app.
_context.notices.trialEndsSoon: {endsAt} is the day the free slot ends.
_context.toast.coworker: Title of a notification from a coworker whose name is not known.

_context.inbox.reasons: Line under a notification row: why it reached the user. {agentName} is a coworker.

notices.rateLimited: {provider} asked {account, select, none {one of your accounts} other {{account}}} to slow down. Your coworkers will not use it for 24 hours, so the account stays safe.
notices.signedOut: {provider} signed {account, select, none {one of your accounts} other {{account}}} out. Reconnect it from Settings → Apps so your coworkers can use it again.
notices.budgetExhausted: Your Rerun credits for this month are used up. Scheduled and triggered runs on Rerun models are paused, and coworkers cannot buy leads, SEO or social data, until they reset or you add credits.
